summary: Careen Lake tower: one new tower built there in 1964 per a DNR annual report; a listing gives its coordinates. No source found describes the site today.

facts.agency: Department of Natural Resources (Saskatchewan), per the 1964-65 annual report

events.note: One new tower built at Careen Lake, recorded in the Department of Natural Resources annual report for 1964-65 as quoted on Canada Lookouts

evidence.supports: Annual report entry for 1964 records one new tower built at Careen Lake
evidence.quote: One new tower was built at Careen Lake.

evidence.supports: The 1964 entry is sourced to the Department of Natural Resources annual report for 1964-65
evidence.quote: Department of Natural Resources Annual report, 1964-65

evidence.supports: Department began building towers across northern Saskatchewan at about fifty-mile intervals
evidence.quote: The Department of Natural Resources soon began constructing fire control towers at approximately fifty-mile intervals across northern Saskatchewan.

evidence.supports: Spacing was chosen so tower men could make radio contact
evidence.quote: This distance was chosen to assure that radio contact could be made between tower men.

evidence.supports: Each tower carried a fire finder, two-way radio and field glasses
evidence.quote: The equipment in the tower, as in all other towers, consisted of a fire finder, two-way radio, and a pair of field glasses.

evidence.supports: Towers ranged from thirty-five to one hundred feet and were wood or steel
evidence.quote: The height of the towers varied from between thirty-five and one hundred feet. They were constructed of either wood or steel.

evidence.supports: Listing gives the Careen Lake site coordinates

sources.title: Towers and Saskatchewan Environment - Big River and Area

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only dated fact is the 1964 entry quoted from the DNR annual report for 1964-65; the listing coordinates match the brief (56-54.6833 N, 108-09.3833 W convert to 56.91139, -108.15639). The brief's agency (Saskatchewan Public Safety Agency, formerly DNR) is not confirmed by any source read; the 1964 report names only the DNR, so the facts.agency value is the 1964 agency. No height, design, staffing, status or current-site source was found. Firelookout.ca slug guesses for this tower returned 404, so no firelookout record was read. Story length reflects the evidence.
